response.justification: Bogdan has strong general software engineering experience and some exposure to AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq, but lacks direct experience with multi-agent AI systems in production, fintech infrastructure, or scaling engineering teams to 30+ in regulated environments. His background is more generalist and web/mobile-focused, with limited depth in distributed systems, real-time inference, or compliance-heavy architectures required for this role.
strengths: Strong software engineering fundamentals with diverse experience across web, mobile, and embedded systems.
Experience with AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling at re:cinq, showing some alignment with agentic AI concepts.
Proven ability to work in polyglot environments and adapt to various tech stacks.
concerns: No demonstrated experience building or operating production-grade multi-agent AI systems in commercial environments.
Limited exposure to fintech infrastructure (credit systems, payment flows, embedded finance) or regulatory compliance.
Lacks direct experience scaling engineering teams to 30+ or developing senior technical leadership layers.
